edbDesc: An optical phenomenon in which circularly or elliptically polarized light undergoes a small shift, transverse to the direction of propagation, when totally internally reflected. This effect is the circular polarisation analog of the Goos-Hänchen effect.
title: Imbert-Fedorov Effect
pickWhy: The sideways shift of reflected light is a fraction of a wavelength, too weak to do a job at a useful size.
